verdicts.reason: A pulls the quote out of the frame, which uncovers a stock placeholder ('BEAUTY ILLUSTRATION / HAND DRAWN ELEMENTS') inside the shrunken frame. The quote sits loose below it, and the attribution floats off to the right with no shared alignment, so the framed-quote concept is lost and the brand looks broken. B keeps the original intact and recognisable, but it is basically the original scaled onto the square with empty margins on the left and right. The 'JEALOUS BECAUSE' and 'THEY CAN'T WEAR' lines still run into the inner frame border, a flaw carried over from the original that should have been fixed.
